schema.description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from EPIC-UE-5.9-CPP-CODING-STANDARD (retrieved 2026-11-27), Naming Conventions: Template classes are prefixed by T; Classes that inherit from UObject are prefixed by U; Classes that inherit from AActor are prefixed by A; Classes that inherit from SWidget are prefixed by S; Classes that are abstract interfaces are prefixed by I; Epic's concept-alike struct types are prefixed by C; Enums are prefixed by E; Boolean variables must be prefixed by b; Most other classes are prefixed by F.
